invaded_niche = pd.concat([invaded_niche, encoded_habitat_df], axis=1)

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t')

# One-hot encode the 'habitat' column
encoder = OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False)
encoded_habitat = encoder.fit_transform(invaded_niche[['habitat']])

# Create a DataFrame with the encoded habitat
encoded_habitat_df = pd.DataFrame(encoded_habitat, columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(['habitat']))

# Drop the original 'habitat' column and join with the encoded DataFrame
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.drop('habitat', axis=1)
invaded_niche = pd.concat([invaded_niche, encoded_habitat_df], axis=1)

# Define the independent variables and the dependent variable
X = invaded_niche[['annual.temperature', 'latitude', 'urban.2009.500m', 'cropland.1956.1000m']]
y = invaded_niche['n.gard']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the multiple regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Display the model summary
model.summary()
